title: Identify European Firaga stack initialization sources
platforms: European ROM; Windows disassembly via Wine
changes: Authenticate five original literal pointers and five copied stack initialization blocks as a scoped source plan.
validation: Protected source plan e324-firaga-14d480-source-plan-52tdqmk9 authenticates 64 unowned source bytes, all sampled by E302, the original LDR operands and stack-copy instruction sequence.
